headline: Reports say Russia is readying a nuclear-armed anti-satellite weapon
summary: Intelligence agencies believe Russia has spent years developing Sputnik-S, a nuclear-armed satellite that could destroy rival satellites in low-Earth orbit. Tom's Hardware reports it is expected to launch before the end of 2026, while Ars Technica reports it could launch as soon as next month. Ars Technica notes a nuclear detonation in space could degrade thousands of satellites.

claims.statement: Intelligence reports say Russia has been developing a nuclear-armed satellite capable of destroying other satellites in orbit.
